scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w packages/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.verify: npm run db:generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test:integration -w apps/api
